{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Velvet slip dress in deep ruby (#9e2a35), midi length falling just above the knee, with a subtle sheen that catches the restaurant lights, cut from soft but structured fabric to hold its shape.  
Block heel pumps in charcoal gray (#36454F), pointed toe, ankle-length shaft, crafted from smooth leather for comfort under a long evening event.  
Gold drop earrings with small dangling elements and a thin gold chain bracelet to add sparkle without overwhelming the dress's rich color.  

This outfit works because the velvet slip dress fulfills her explicit wish to wear a dress while offering enough structure for an upscale restaurant setting. The deep ruby hue complements her warm skin tone and stands out elegantly against the artificial lighting of the evening celebration. Minimal jewelry keeps the focus on the dress itself, creating a balanced look that feels both special and comfortable throughout the night."}
